10:00 Local Time, 09:00 GMT, 14:30 IST: The art of being mercurial comes naturally to one team. However, the other team has acquired it over the last couple of years. The similarity doesn't end there. Both have new skippers. And both of them had the tag of former skippers for sometime before being elevated to the post once again. Hello and welcome to the first Test between England and Pakistan. The venue for the first game is Headingley, Leeds!

England have won their last 6 Tests here. And the last time these two teams played here was in 2018 when England hammered Pakistan by an innings and 55 runs. So, it would be an understatement if we say England are massive favourites coming into this game.  And there is another interesting thing, England have batted second in all the 6 Tests winning two of them by an innings margin. That is how much they have enjoyed playing at Headlingley of late. We won't be surprised if they do the same again!
